newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize weaker in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize weaker in dull trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was steady to weaker in slow trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with rosy crop weather and export buyers finding their committments largely covered, traders said.

Cash January wheat was stable in middling volume, in a market undisturbed by novelty. Cash new crop soybeans slipped. Cash sunflower seed was steady in moderate turnover, with crusher's stocks high and oil prices weak.
